provenance.routeGeometry: User-supplied Garmin FIT record coordinates, CRC-validated, privacy-trimmed, split at recording/timer gaps, and sampled every 5 active seconds.
provenance.rideSummaries: Full-file Garmin FIT session totals; route redaction does not change ride totals.
provenance.telemetry: Thirty-second active-time aggregates, grouped within continuous recording segments; no interpolation across pauses or gaps.
provenance.segmentIdentity: SCCC WhatsApp competition links reconciled to the athlete's Strava activity effort payloads and Garmin FIT telemetry.
provenance.segmentGeometry: Rider-specific FIT slices. Four use reviewed exact FIT timestamps; eleven use deterministic multi-metric reconciliation to Strava effort targets.
provenance.contentHashDefinition: SHA-256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON after removing contentHash; object keys recursively sorted, array order preserved, no whitespace.

caveats: The public route is intentionally incomplete within 1 km of the recurrent lodging/base endpoint cluster.
FIT-derived segment paths show where this rider rode; they are not canonical Strava polylines.
Strava distance is map-matched and may differ slightly from Garmin device distance for the same segment.
Ride 3's barometric altitude baseline is offset below sea level; use the terrain surface and relative climbing rather than its absolute recorded altitude.
Garmin-recorded temperature is device telemetry, not a calibrated ambient-weather observation.
Puig Maria was planned/mentioned but not completed or matched; it is a caveat rather than one of the 17 reviewed segment-ledger rows.
